title: World Painter: drag-to-move for placed areas and paint cells

sections.what: Moving placed areas or cells in World Painter is cumbersome. For paint cells: there's a 'move' tool that nudges selected cells one at a time via arrow buttons (up/down/left/right). For placed areas: you must unplace the area (click in area tool) then re-place it at the new cell. There's no drag-to-move for areas, and the move tool only works on paint layers, not placed areas/features.
sections.why: User wants to easily reposition placed areas (like rooms in millwood__public_school scope) and painted cells. Current workflow requires multiple clicks and tool switches. The cell panel has a 'Move [area name]' button but it just switches to area tool - you still have to click the new cell.
sections.how:
Two possible improvements:
1. For areas: Add drag-to-move in area tool - click and drag an already-placed area to a new cell (like moving a token).
2. For paint cells: The move tool already exists but only nudges 1 cell at a time via buttons. Could add drag-to-move for selected cells.
3. Consider a unified 'move' tool that works on both selected paint cells AND placed areas/features.
sections.verify:
1. npm run build:ts compiles static/js/worldpainter/editor.ts with 0 errors.
2. Dragging an already-placed area in Area or Move tool draws an emerald dashed ghost preview + connector line in _drawSelection and commits via single place_area POST (one undo step).
3. Dragging selected paint cells in Move tool draws shifted ghost outlines for all selected cells and commits via single _nudge(p, dx, dy) paint_batch POST (one undo step).

acceptance.text: In area tool: click and drag an already-placed area to move it to a new cell (with visual feedback)
In move tool: drag selected cells to new position (not just nudge buttons)
Both operations are single undo steps

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: World Painter editor (scopes with grid and placed areas)

Current availability: Always

Live steps when available:
1. Open World Painter for millwood__public_school scope
2. Place an area on the grid (area tool)
3. Switch to move tool or stay in area tool
4. Click and drag the placed area to a new cell
5. Release - area moves to new cell in one undo step

This section defines intended access and live acceptance. It is not a claim that planned UI exists or works today. Current availability says what is implemented and verified now; the numbered steps say how to reach and test the intended surface once it is available.
